questions.question: After the Israelites turned away to serve other gods, the LORD sold them into the hands of which two nations?
The LORD told Israel that when the Egyptians and Amorites oppressed them and they cried out, He did not save them. True or false?
After the LORD told Israel to ask their chosen gods for help, what did the Israelites do with the foreign gods among them?

answers.text: Put them away and served the LORD
Hid them and kept serving them

questions.question: When the Ammonites camped in Gilead to fight Israel, what did the rulers of Gilead say whoever led the attack would become?

answers.text: Head of all who live in Gilead
